name: scalive-quiz-arena
description: SCALive Quiz Arena — real-time classroom quiz platform for Sharma Computer Academy, Bhopal

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c auto "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -k -n db,app -c auto "npm run db:local" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5433 && npm run db:migrate && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.start: npm run db:migrate && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
